content.heading: ### Passage (Questions 48–50)
content.text: "Like a three dimensional world the nervous system has been given three axes of its own which help in understanding the spatial relationships among various neural structures. One axis goes from the back or the dorsal to the front or the ________. Another goes from the nose or head of the animal to the tail or ________. The third axis capitalizes on the fact that many gross structures are duplicated on either side of the animal, so that we can establish a midline axis. Areas close to this are ________ portions, and those areas to each side of it ________ portions."

questions.question: Fill the blank for appropriate space :
questions.concept: Dorsal-ventral axis in neuroanatomy — dorsal is back, ventral is front

questions.question: Fill the blank at 49th mark in paragraph :
questions.concept: Anterior-posterior axis — anterior (head/nose) to posterior (tail)

questions.question: Fill the paired spaces at marked 50 :
questions.concept: Medial-lateral axis — medial near midline, lateral toward sides
